summary: MSc Data Science student at FAU Erlangen-Nürnberg with hands-on experience applying large language models (LLMs) and setting up the evaluation loops that make their output usable. Designed prompts and embedding-based retrieval on Google Vertex AI and deployed an LLM application to Vertex AI managed endpoints. Delivered 10+ production-ready models during an AI and ML internship, recognised as Best Performer, with results measured in R², ROC-AUC, mAP and silhouette rather than asserted. Cloud operations background covering infrastructure automation and monitoring of cloud workloads. Based in Erlangen, available up to 20 h/week during the semester and full time during official semester breaks.

bullets: Recognised as Best Performer of the cohort: completed 8 end-to-end machine learning projects and delivered 10+ production-ready models across the supervised and unsupervised spectrum.

Selected and reported the evaluation metric that fitted each problem: 95%+ ROC-AUC on a Support Vector Machine tuned by GridSearchCV hyperparameter search, 96%+ accuracy on breast-cancer diagnosis with Logistic Regression, R² above 0.90 on housing-price regression.
Built a Walmart weekly-sales forecasting model with XGBoost, reaching 96.1% R² and reducing forecast error by 18%.
Segmented 200 customers into five actionable clusters with K-Means at a silhouette score of 0.55.
Ran exploratory data analysis on the Titanic dataset covering distribution analysis, missing-value treatment and feature relationships.
Set up evaluation loops against Vertex AI managed endpoints to measure and improve the quality of model output after deployment.
Built an ATS Resume Checker powered by large language models: parsing resumes, scoring them against job descriptions and returning structured feedback.
Designed and iterated LLM prompts and embedding-based retrieval on Google Vertex AI.
Set up monitoring for cloud workloads and automated recurring infrastructure tasks.
Operated and supported VMware virtualisation infrastructure.
Applied and enforced security guidelines across managed environments.
Built an American Sign Language image-recognition system with a Convolutional Neural Network in PyTorch.
Implemented the full training, validation and inference pipeline, including data augmentation to improve generalisation.

publications.description: Deep-learning surveillance on live CCTV feeds. Weapon detection with YOLOv11 and hard negative mining to suppress false positives from visually similar objects; face recognition via a ResNet-based detector, FaceNet embeddings and an SVM classifier. Reported 95.79% mAP@0.5 with precision and recall both at 0.93, and 93.75% accuracy for face recognition. Led as team leader; personally optimised the object-detection model for real-time inference on standard hardware, integrated the face-recognition pipeline with privacy and ethical considerations in the design, and tuned the system to cut false alarms while holding accuracy. Awarded Best Paper at ICISD 2025.
